circulation_discretization.convention: Material arc coordinate s in [-L/2,L/2]; theta=acos(2*arc/L-1), decreasing pi to zero. Gamma=sum A_k sin(k theta). Weighted residual=(2/pi) sum R_i sin(k theta_i) delta_theta_i.
circulation_discretization.scope: Fourier modes are per logical lifting beam; refine mode count and structural intervals independently. Local flow defects need not vanish in a truncated series.

section_output_definitions.cm: Local chord/4 pitching-moment coefficient, including flap mixing and the actual section-normal Mach correction; excludes moment arms and apparent-mass moments.
section_output_definitions.f_aero: Circulatory plus enabled circulation-rate force projected on the physical current section normal, per current length [input F/L]. Profile drag, apparent mass and point loads are excluded.
section_output_definitions.f_reac: Distributed real-mass gravity/inertia plus apparent-mass force projected on the physical current section normal, per current length [input F/L]. Excludes point masses, engines, struts, applied point loads and support reactions.
section_output_definitions.f_reac_sampling: Source mounted analysis: endpoint-averaged distributed gravity force per interval divided by current aerodynamic interval length. Point masses excluded.
section_output_definitions.da_eff: (n - n_jig) dot V_relative / |V_relative| [rad], using physical section normals and total relative velocity at the bound-vortex force point. This is the documented linearized incidence change, not an exact angle difference. Undefined at zero relative speed.
section_output_definitions.sampling: Aerodynamic quantities use material Glauert midpoint stations. Inertial forces are interval averages, reported at those stations. No half-interval shift to structural nodes is applied.

lifting_airflow.scope: Relative fluid velocity at each lifting force point, including induced flow, gusts, jets and local section motion. Normal speed excludes the component along the current span axis. Local Mach uses atmospheric sound speed, independently of the selected PG Mach.
lifting_airflow.sampling: Current bound-vortex force points; these differ from the reported beam-axis strip positions.
lifting_airflow.validity: Subsonic local Mach is necessary, not sufficient for physical validity or mesh convergence. Swept lifting lines can develop growing force-point velocities under refinement.

aerodynamic_influences.ground: Current Earth pose and image plane; coefficients update when the plane changes.
aerodynamic_influences.scope: Vortex and volume velocity coefficients. Current circulation, section frames, lengths, motion, gusts, jets and loads remain active.

wake_core.rule: max(ratio * local chord, current interval length)
wake_core.scope: Lifting-surface interactions within one physical beam use zero core. Distinct physical beams and external probes/objects use the configured cores; images inherit the selected influence core.

aerodynamic_lag.apparent_mass: Retained independently of the aerodynamic-lag setting.

trefftz.convention: Frozen straight wake, infinite trailing filaments, theta-midpoint quadrature; D=-rho/2 sum(Gamma v_wake dot (wind cross delta_r)).
trefftz.scope: Lifting-surface circulation only; no body/profile/engine/apparent-mass drag or shed-wake history.
trefftz.efficiency_definition: (CLi^2+CYi^2)/(pi*(Bref^2/Sref)*CDi); zero by reporting convention for an exactly unloaded, nonempty lifting wake.

coefficient_definitions.Cl: Negative body-x moment about Reference row 2, divided by q*Sref*Bref
coefficient_definitions.Cm: Body-y moment about Reference row 2, divided by q*Sref*Cref
coefficient_definitions.Cn: Negative body-z moment about Reference row 2, divided by q*Sref*Bref
coefficient_definitions.Cm_origin: Body-y moment about the body origin, divided by q*Sref*Cref; same load scope as Cm

moment_definitions.scope: Aerodynamic, apparent-mass, point-object drag and engine loads; excludes real-mass gravity/inertia and support reactions.
moment_definitions.distributed_scope: Distributed lift/profile loads, including body shoulders; excludes apparent mass, point objects and engines.

reference_flow.definition: Relative air velocity at the fixed body velocity reference: -U_origin - Omega cross r_ref + posed Earth gust. Induced flow and local elastic velocity are excluded.
reference_flow.angle_convention: Degrees: alpha=atan2(w,u), beta=atan2(-v,hypot(u,w)); undefined or roundoff-sized directions are null.

limitations: Source moving-frame state with endpoint real inertia/damping and Glauert unsteady aerodynamic loads; temporal and spatial refinement are required.
The averaged transform is generally not a rotation. Element local components use transform_average; the physical midpoint frame is for geometric display only.

Eq. 54 uses inverse averaged bending/torsion stiffness. EA, GK and offsets are averaged before applying Eqs. 18–19; ds is unloaded arc. These property/length interpretations are not proven historical executable conventions.
Element constitutive estimates use averaged shell properties. Endpoint traces and sensor strains use their one-sided section properties; exact ASWING output sampling remains unverified.

Distributed loads average completed endpoint products and transfer each interval wrench symmetrically. Section rotary inertia includes steady Eq.80 exactly once, using unloaded interval length. For varying properties this finite-difference mass operator need not be symmetric; it is not a finite-element kinetic-energy mass matrix. Historical executable discretization and modal reference agreement remain unverified.

Angular inertia includes Omega cross omega from inertial differentiation of angular momentum; printed unsteady Eqs.40/47 omit this term. Global loads use the same symmetric interval transfer as local equilibrium (Eq.266). This explicitly declared interpretation is not established historical ASWING executable parity.

mesh_discretization.coordinates: Undeformed material arc length; theta decreases from pi to zero. Rigid position jumps contain no beam material.

mass_properties.scope: Mass and first moment describe the source gravity rule. Dynamic inertia uses the endpoint-product descriptor operator, including section and point inertia. No single symmetric aggregate spatial tensor is asserted for this finite-difference rule.

structure.sample_location: element constitutive average; t is its material-midpoint plot coordinate
structure.shell_sampling: Inward endpoint properties averaged before interval strain/stress recovery; endpoint_traces use exact sided properties.
structure.peak_sampling: Interval estimates and both endpoint traces; no extrapolation through load or property jumps.
limitations: Interval local components use the arithmetic endpoint transform average, not the orthonormal physical midpoint display frame.
Interval strain follows the selected averaged stiffness/force law. Averaged shell properties give a constitutive interval estimate, not a point sample or an average of endpoint stress.
Endpoint strains use one-sided section properties and conservative endpoint resultants. Both sides of load/property jumps remain distinct.
Shell coordinates are measured from the tension axis per steady Eq.28. Exact historical ASWING output sampling remains unverified.

Closed-shell torsional shear uses translated Mprime_s/(2*Atshell). Missing shell arms or nonpositive area leave unavailable values null; strength, warping and transverse-shear stresses are not inferred.

output_scope.authoritative: Nodes, reactions, source constitutive element estimates, one-sided endpoint resultants/section recovery and sensor-anchor sections.
output_scope.material_charts: Surface steady Eqs.4/9 and fuselage Eqs.11/12. Vertical fuselage spans and x-directed surface spans are chart poles; spatial Euler branch cuts remain unsupported.
output_scope.element_coordinates: t locates the interval on plots; interval strains use the source averaged law. endpoint_traces contain actual sided point samples.
output_scope.deformed_interval_measure: drela-eq48-average-strain-norm-v1: constant-average-strain arc measure ||solve((Ra+Rb)/2, rb-ra)|| from Eq.48 physical endpoint frames. Material arc/theta stay fixed. The quadrature for nonuniform endpoint strains is not established historical executable behavior.
output_scope.strain_components: source_discrete_elements.axial_strain is reference-axis epsilon_s; elements.axial_strain_tension is Fs/EA. Closed-shell shear uses the translated elastic-axis torque.
output_scope.aerodynamic_load_transfer: Glauert aerodynamic section wrenches are transferred symmetrically about the structural midpoint; real inertia retains source endpoint averaging. No second apparent-mass matrix is added.

limitations: Sensor axes and locations follow their rigid pylons. Relative body position/velocity describe the beam anchor; GPS and inertial measurements describe the pylon tip.
Structural loads and strain use the inward endpoint and left trace at an interior sensor anchor, each in its actual one-sided section frame. Both adjacent traces remain available.
Shell strain/stress use the selected one-sided properties at the sensor anchor, not an adjacent element average. Exact historical ASWING trace choice at jumps remains unverified.
Vacuum dynamics has no airflow; flow quantities remain unavailable.
Zero airspeed makes flow angles undefined. At a vertical sensor V axis, bank/heading are undefined; Euler-angle branches are not a global attitude representation.

scope: One production UA-2 continuation step plus the original endpoint event selection; CPython-to-WASM portability, not native ASWING or a full periodic run.
